note: Conditions are business situations that create demand for a job. Which archetypes have which conditions is scored by Jev once (archetype x condition Nouls) and cached; overrides live in condition_overrides. JTBDs map to the conditions that create demand for them; this mapping is the curated, counterintuitive part (e.g. commission calculation is needed wherever pay depends on deals, placements or transactions, not only where there is a RevOps team).

conditions.commissioned_sales_reps: Employs salespeople whose pay includes commission on deals they close
conditions.independent_agents_brokers: Revenue comes through agents or brokers who earn a commission per sale or policy
conditions.per_placement_or_per_transaction_pay: Staff earn fees, bonuses or splits per placement, booking, job or transaction
conditions.quota_carrying_sales_team: Has a sales team with revenue targets or quotas
conditions.outside_field_sales: Salespeople visit customers in person or cover territories
conditions.dealer_or_channel_network: Sells through dealers, resellers, distributors or channel partners
conditions.recurring_subscription_revenue: Customers pay recurring subscriptions or contracts
conditions.account_renewals_expansion: Depends on renewing and growing existing customer accounts
conditions.long_b2b_sales_cycle: Sells to businesses with multi-step sales cycles and proposals
conditions.high_volume_lead_generation: Depends on generating many inbound or outbound leads
conditions.large_hourly_frontline_workforce: Most staff are hourly or frontline workers
conditions.shift_scheduling: Staff work rotating shifts that must be scheduled
conditions.high_hiring_volume: Hires many people continuously or has high turnover
conditions.field_service_technicians: Sends technicians or crews to customer sites
conditions.fleet_vehicles: Operates a fleet of vehicles or trucks
conditions.multi_location_operations: Runs many branches, stores or locations
conditions.project_based_billing: Bills clients per project, job or engagement
conditions.hourly_professional_billing: Bills clients for professionals' time by the hour
conditions.rental_or_leased_assets: Earns revenue by renting or leasing assets
conditions.heavy_regulatory_compliance: Operates under heavy licensing, audit or regulatory requirements
conditions.patient_or_client_records: Handles sensitive patient, client or personal records
conditions.handles_financial_transactions: Moves money, processes payments or extends credit
conditions.complex_quotes_pricing: Builds custom quotes, configurations or price lists for deals
conditions.customer_support_volume: Handles a high volume of customer support requests
conditions.ecommerce_online_sales: Sells online through a web store or marketplace
conditions.consumer_customers: Sells mainly to consumers rather than businesses
conditions.franchise_or_affiliate_network: Operates through franchisees, affiliates or licensees
conditions.donor_or_member_funded: Funded by donors, grants or member dues
conditions.government_contracts: Wins revenue through public tenders or government contracts
conditions.manufacturing_production: Runs production lines or manufacturing operations
conditions.supply_chain_procurement: Buys materials or goods from many suppliers
conditions.marketing_content_production: Produces marketing campaigns or content continuously
conditions.events_bookings: Revenue depends on bookings, reservations or events
